Apartments, villas and hospitality property in Bali.

name: Yves Preissler
headline: Wellness with a business perspective.
intro: Yves Preissler Business Consulting develops fitness, wellness and recovery concepts for hotels, gyms and residential settings.
body: The team combines business consulting with detailed turnkey fitness solutions. Its work includes new gym concepts, wellness programs and improvements to existing clubs.
services: Gym and health club consulting
Concepts and practical support for new and existing fitness businesses.
Hospitality fitness consulting
Fitness propositions tailored to hotels and their guests.
Recovery and wellness
Programs and facilities that connect guest needs with the business model.
Residential fitness
Bespoke fitness concepts for residential developments and home gyms.
collaboration: Specialist wellness input
Fitness, recovery and wellness concepts need dedicated expertise. Yves Preissler’s focus complements Zenith’s broader hospitality planning.
Experience linked to the business model
Its combination of consulting and fitness solutions supports a conversation about both the guest proposition and the practical delivery of the facility.
A connected operating brief
Working from a shared brief helps align the wellness offer with the wider property, its guests and its operating team.

name: Iber Homes
headline: A place, a purpose, a workable model.
intro: IBER HOMES develops concepts and strategies for nature-based destinations and places to stay.
body: Its approach considers the site, intended guest, experience, architecture and economics together. It then connects the specialists and partners needed to move a concept forward.
services: Place and concept research
Explore the location, market, intended guests and potential of a site.
Business and experience models
Bring space, guest experience and economics into one concept.
Development coordination
Connect architects, manufacturers, builders and operators around an agreed direction.
note: Its website uses credited illustrative imagery; a dedicated partner gallery will be added when selected images are provided.
collaboration: Concept and economics in one conversation
IBER HOMES considers the site, guest experience, architecture and economics together, complementing Zenith’s focus on commercially grounded hospitality.
A response to place
Its nature-based destination focus brings a useful perspective to projects where the setting is central to the intended stay.
Continuity between specialists
Its development coordination approach supports a shared direction across designers, builders and operators.

name: Anton Petrov
headline: Spaces shaped by people and place.
intro: APA Architects, led by Anton Petrov, designs residences, hospitality destinations and private real estate developments.
body: The studio connects buildings and interiors with landscape and history, bringing a human-centered approach to function, experience and design.
services: Architecture
Design for residential, hospitality and private development projects.
Interior design
Interiors considered alongside the building and its setting.
Place-led design
A focus on landscape, context and the people who use each space.
collaboration: Design with operating input
APA’s architecture and interiors focus complements Zenith’s hospitality brief, bringing the intended guest experience and everyday use into the design conversation.
A connection to place

name: 3dscan.id
headline: Explore real spaces, digitally.
intro: 3dScan.id provides professional 3D capture, digital twins and virtual tours for properties and businesses in Indonesia.
body: Its Matterport-based models help people explore spaces remotely and support property marketing, project coordination and communication.
services: 3D scanning
Capture physical spaces using professional LiDAR and digital twin technology.
Virtual property tours
Interactive walkthroughs for hospitality, residential and commercial properties.
Architecture and construction
Digital spatial records that support collaboration and project planning.
Model management
Hosted models with notes, links, video and other useful information.
collaboration: A shared view of the space
3dScan.id’s digital twins give owners and project teams a way to explore and discuss a property remotely.
Clearer project conversations
Spatial records and model annotations can support coordination by giving stakeholders a common visual reference.
A link between property and presentation
Virtual walkthroughs complement hospitality marketing by helping prospective guests and partners understand the spaces they are considering.
